import {
  connect,
  type Connection,
  type ConnectionWithLabels,
  type ConnectionWithLinkAdditions,
  type IssueTracker,
  type IssueTrackerWithLabels,
  type IssueTrackerWithLinkAdditions,
  type SubIssueLinkAddition,
} from "@lutzseverino/postern";

const concrete = connect("https://github.com/octo/hello");
export const additions = concrete.issueTracker.subIssueLinkAdditions(1);
export const connection: ConnectionWithLinkAdditions = concrete;
export const tracker: IssueTrackerWithLinkAdditions = concrete.issueTracker;
export const legacyConnection: Connection = concrete;
export const labelsConnection: ConnectionWithLabels = concrete;
export const legacyTracker: IssueTracker = concrete.issueTracker;
export const labelsTracker: IssueTrackerWithLabels = concrete.issueTracker;

type Equal<A, B> =
  (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export type AdditionsResult = Assert<Equal<typeof additions, Promise<SubIssueLinkAddition[]>>>;
export type RequiredHistory = Assert<Equal<
  IssueTrackerWithLinkAdditions["subIssueLinkAdditions"],
  (number: number) => Promise<SubIssueLinkAddition[]>
>>;
export const unknown: SubIssueLinkAddition = { subIssue: null, actor: null, time: null };
export const unknownBot: SubIssueLinkAddition = {
  subIssue: { repository: "other/project", number: 2, state: "closed" },
  actor: { login: "helper", bot: null },
  time: "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z",
};
